items.title: GTF x ASAF
items.summary: George Town Festival joins hands with Ansan Street Arts Festival (ASAF), one of South Korea’s leading outdoor performing arts festivals, for a vibrant cross-cultural exchange that transforms public spaces into stages for…
items.detail: George Town Festival joins hands with Ansan Street Arts Festival (ASAF), one of South Korea’s leading outdoor performing arts festivals, for a vibrant cross-cultural exchange that transforms public spaces into stages for imagination, connection, and discovery. Bringing together a diverse programme of street theatre, site-specific dance, physical theatre, and non-verbal performance, GTF × ASAF celebrates the power of the performing arts to transcend language and cultural boundaries. From poetic reflections on memory and identity to contemporary reinterpretations of folklore, magical family adventures, and playful encounters in unexpected places, each performance invites audiences to experience the city through fresh perspectives. items.summary: Step beyond the stage with “Kopi & Karya”, a festival F&B trail that transforms George Town’s cafés into spaces of creativity and connection. Discover exclusive festival-inspired drinks and artisan bakes crafted by 10 lo…
items.detail: Step beyond the stage with “Kopi & Karya”, a festival F&B trail that transforms George Town’s cafés into spaces of creativity and connection. Discover exclusive festival-inspired drinks and artisan bakes crafted by 10 local cafés, each offering a delicious interpretation of this year’s theme, “Beyond Boundaries”. From comforting cups of coffee to inventive sweet treats, every stop is a chance to experience the city through its flavours. Because at George Town Festival, art isn’t just something you watch—it is something you taste.

items.title: Artisan II
items.summary: Step into the forgotten workshops of George Town in “Artisan II” by Low Chee Peng. Inspired by the city’s master craftsmen and the traditional trades that once filled its streets, this immersive exhibition captures the s…
items.detail: Step into the forgotten workshops of George Town in “Artisan II” by Low Chee Peng. Inspired by the city’s master craftsmen and the traditional trades that once filled its streets, this immersive exhibition captures the spirit of artisans whose skills were passed down through generations. As these workshops disappear from the urban landscape, “Artisan II” invites audiences to rediscover the people, places, and heritage that helped shape the soul of George Town.

items.title: Collodion, Silver, Glass: Contemporary Wet Plate Photography
items.summary: Step into the captivating world of “Collodion, Silver, Glass: Contemporary Wet Plate Photography”, where nineteenth-century photographic techniques meet contemporary artistic vision. Featuring the work of Steve Tan (陈兴国)…
items.detail: Step into the captivating world of “Collodion, Silver, Glass: Contemporary Wet Plate Photography”, where nineteenth-century photographic techniques meet contemporary artistic vision. Featuring the work of Steve Tan (陈兴国), Malaysia’s only professional wet plate photographer, this exhibition showcases hauntingly beautiful portraits and still lifes created through a painstaking process that transforms glass, silver, and light into timeless images. Alongside the exhibition, audiences can discover the craftsmanship behind this rare medium through demonstrations and workshops, offering a glimpse into one of photography’s earliest—and most enchanting—forms.

items.title: Converge 匯聚
items.summary: Emerging from the earth like a living organism, “Converge” by Taiwanese artist Kuei-Chih Lee transforms Taman Kejiranan Macallum into a space where nature, people, and the city come together. Inspired by George Town’s hi…
items.detail: Emerging from the earth like a living organism, “Converge” by Taiwanese artist Kuei-Chih Lee transforms Taman Kejiranan Macallum into a space where nature, people, and the city come together. Inspired by George Town’s history as a port city shaped by migration and cultural exchange, the large-scale installation reflects on coexistence through five sculptural forms that rise organically from the ground. Intertwining like a growing settlement, the structures merge into a single collective form, echoing the many communities, languages, and traditions that have long flourished in Penang.

items.title: The Natural History Museum of Yeahnahnesia by Yok and Sheryo
items.summary: Cultprint, Penang hosts “The Natural History Museum of Yeahnahnesia”, presented by artist duo Yok & Sheryo, curated by Deborah Lim, and realised in collaboration with SPUTNIKFOREST. The museum brings together a collectio…
items.detail: Cultprint, Penang hosts “The Natural History Museum of Yeahnahnesia”, presented by artist duo Yok & Sheryo, curated by Deborah Lim, and realised in collaboration with SPUTNIKFOREST. The museum brings together a collection of rare artefacts, specimens and cultural objects—many exhibited publicly for the first time—offering an introduction to the island nation of Yeahnahnesia. Entrusted to the artists by the island’s guardians, these objects reveal its natural history, rituals and traditions, offering insight into a civilisation shaped by balance, playfulness and unhurried living. items.title: 槟将办100小时不间断印度棍术接力 挑战马来西亚纪录大全
items.summary: 图说：黄汉伟（左4）为100小时不间断印度棍术表演接力活动打气。右3为博尔卡莱印度棍术协会主席卡威古玛。 ///// 槟城博尔卡莱印度棍术协会（Porr Kalai Silambam）将于8月28日至9月1日，在马来西亚理科大学举办“100小时不间断印度棍术表演接力”活动，挑战马来西亚纪录大全，来自全国多个州属及联邦直辖区的印度棍术好手将参与其中。 槟州旅游与创意经济行政议员黄汉伟今日在新闻发布会上表示，这项活动并非一般的印度棍术表演，…
items.detail: 图说：黄汉伟（左4）为100小时不间断印度棍术表演接力活动打气。右3为博尔卡莱印度棍术协会主席卡威古玛。 ///// 槟城博尔卡莱印度棍术协会（Porr Kalai Silambam）将于8月28日至9月1日，在马来西亚理科大学举办“100小时不间断印度棍术表演接力”活动，挑战马来西亚纪录大全，来自全国多个州属及联邦直辖区的印度棍术好手将参与其中。 槟州旅游与创意经济行政议员黄汉伟今日在新闻发布会上表示，这项活动并非一般的印度棍术表演，而是一项结合体育与文化遗产的大型计划。 他说，约150人参与这项活动，他们来自槟城、吉打、霹雳、玻璃市、登嘉楼、森美兰、马六甲、彭亨、雪兰莪及吉隆坡的参与，充分显示全国印度棍术社群对这项活动的关注与支持。 “值得一提的是，许多参赛者刚完成雪兰莪大马运动会赛事，如今继续投入这项具有历史意义的活动，展现了他们的纪律、毅力及对印度棍术的热爱。” 他指出，参赛者不只是为了表演而来，同时代表各自州属，并共同为马来西亚印度棍术发展开启新篇章。 黄汉伟说，槟城印度棍术的发展已迈入令人鼓舞的新阶段，印度棍术于2026年正式列为槟州文化遗产，是极具里程碑意义的发展。 “州文化遗产的认可，将有助于确保印度棍术持续获得保存、发展，并传承给下一代。” 他同时肯定博尔卡莱印度棍术协会长期以来在槟城社区所扮演的积极角色，除了推动印度棍术活动，也积极参与青年发展、文化、体育及社区计划，并与州政府合作落实各项倡议。 “博尔卡莱印度棍术协会是非政府组织成为政府策略伙伴的典范，尤其是在青年发展、文化、遗产及创意经济领域。” 他指出，要完成100小时不间断表演绝非易事，需要周密策划、高度纪律、充沛的身心力量，以及完善的参赛者、教练和志愿者管理、安全措施和各方协调。 黄汉伟认为，从旅游与创意经济角度来看，这类活动具有很高价值，州政府希望文化遗产不仅作为历史被铭记，更能持续活跃、发展
